sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx, 160x120, 17 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD < 40 mK; optical: 1/2.7" CMOS
features: thermal + optical bi-spectrum camera with image fusion / picture-in-picture
thermal detector: uncooled VOx 160x120, 17 um pixel pitch, < 40 mK, 8-14 um

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal and optical exposed as separate channels (optical Channel 1 / thermal Channel 2).

release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2TD2617-3 is a thermal & optical bi-spectrum network bullet camera pairing a 160x120 uncooled VOx thermal detector (3.1 mm lens) with a 4 MP (2688x1520) optical channel, aimed at perimeter protection and early fire prevention. It offers temperature measurement (-20 to 150 C), dynamic fire detection and VCA analytics. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet DS-2TD2617-3_QA_Datasheet_en-US_20231018.pdf.
